g.text: A single multiplicative correction cannot recover the A.1 identifiability floor
C | The protocol correction is strongly material dependent
Protocol A remains archived and unchanged. All headline eligibility and certification statistics use the frozen Protocol A.1 definition.
Protocol A.1 replaces the archived float32 perturbation probe with a frozen five-seed uniform-noise probe at the same float32 L-infinity amplitude.
Figure 4 | Stability is a property of the observable and its measurement protocol
